title: FIR Halfband Decimator
text: Decimate signal using polyphase FIR halfband filter, 1 input, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Design method} sets Filter design method; {Filter specification} sets the filter design parameters Transition width and stopband, {Filter order}, {Transition width (Hz)} sets the transition width 4.1e3, {Stopband attenuation (dB)}, {Numerator} sets the fIR halfband filter coefficients, {Output highpass subband}, {Sample rate mode} sets the mode to specify the input sample rate Use normalized, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input signal, {Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals}, {View Filter Response}, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Rounding mode} and {Coefficients} sets the word and fraction lengths of coefficients. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: LP
ports.summary: Lowpass subband of decimator output column vector | matrix

ports.name: HP
ports.summary: Highpass subband of decimator output column vector | matrix

params.name: Filter specification
params.values: Filter design parameters Transition width and stopband attenuation (default) | Filter order and transition width | Filter order and stopband attenuation | Coefficients

params.name: Numerator
params.values: FIR halfband filter coefficients designHalfbandFIR(’TransitionWidth’,0.186, ’StopbandAttenuation’,80, ’Structure’,’decim’) (default) | row vector

params.name: Design method
params.values: Filter design method Auto (default) | Equiripple | Kaiser

params.name: Sample rate mode
params.values: Mode to specify the input sample rate Use normalized frequency (0 to 1) (default) | Specify on dialog | Inherit from input port

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input signal 44100 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals
params.values: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for output fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: Word and fraction lengths of coefficients fixdt(1,16) (default) | fixdt(1,16,0)
